title: Wednesday Addams Totem
description: This texture pack changes your totem to Wednesday Addams.
body:
# 🕸️ Wednesday Addams Totem 🕸️
This texture packs pack changes your Totem of Undying to look like Wednesday Addams! Now you can get the "Second life" in style with a darker look.

**==============================================================**

##  Why did I make this?


I love the show and I play Minecraft every day. I wanted to bring them together so I can "kill two birds with one stone" (do two things at once!). 🦇

**==============================================================**

New Look: The totem is now a Wednesday character.
More to Come: This is my first pack. I will make more character totems soon!

### 💬 **Talk to me**
If you have any problems or a fire idea for a new texture pack, add me on Discord:

  > iblowqrystals is my username.

**==============================================================**

**_📜 Credits_**
Thanks to these which made this texture pack possible and Alive :D
